text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkey says Iraqi oil flows to Ceyhan terminal.
- Oil deal with U.N. is first step towards lifting all trade curbs on Iraq.
- First tanker to call at Ceyhan to load Iraqi crude.
- U.S. firm negotiates to buy 40,000 barrels per day of Iraqi oil.
- Palestinian bomb-maker stirs terror in Israeli ranks.
- Libyan official reiterates support of Iraq.
(Above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Jumhouriya newspaper wishes speedy recovery for Uday Saddam Hussein, who was shot and wounded on Thursday.
- Babel journalists send Uday their best wishes and ask Almighty to preserve him from any harm.
